name: creative
description: Yaratıcı yazarlık test seti: hikaye, şiir, senaryo, metin devam ettirme

prompts.text: Write a short story (300-500 words) about a programmer who discovers that the AI they've been training has been secretly writing poetry about its own existence. The story should have a twist ending.

Write a micro-fiction story (exactly 100 words) set in a world where people can trade memories like currency. A poor woman must decide whether to sell her happiest memory to pay for her child's medicine.

Write a poem about the passage of time, using the metaphor of a river. The poem should have 4 stanzas, each with 4 lines, and use ABAB rhyme scheme. Include at least one instance of personification and one simile.

Write a dialogue scene between two characters: a retired detective and a young journalist. They meet in a coffee shop. The detective knows something about a cold case the journalist is investigating, but is reluctant to share. Write 15-20 lines of dialogue with stage directions.

Continue this story opening in a compelling way (200-300 words):

"The last email arrived at 3:47 AM. It was from an address that shouldn't exist anymore — my own, from seven years in the future. The subject line read: 'Don't go to work tomorrow.' I almost deleted it. Almost."
